title: Bingo Game
description: Unique minecraft bingo plugin which is fully customizable!
body:
# Minecraft-Bingo

## About the plugin
This is a mini-game type of plugin, you get a bingo card and you need to collect all items in a specific row to gain a bingo. You can get bingo horizontally, vertically and diagonal. All items can be used for the bingo and can be manually set up in the configuration file.

![Card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfd92ad6f0107a3345aa811dcb5b34b5ca2d42e8.png)

## Installation and Usage

### Installation
1. Download the plugin
2. Put "Bingo.jar" in your plugins folder
3. Restart the server

### Usage
1. Get an admin to start a new bingo game using /bingo start
2. Then use /bingo join to join the bingo game.
3. Open up your bingo card and start collecting!

## Commands
/bingo
/bingo help
/bingo info
/bingo join
/bingo see
/bingo start (Admins)

## Admin permission
Admins need the "bingo.admin" permission node in order to start a game.

## Configuration file
* All options have explanation with them in the configuration file so it is user friendly and easy to configure.

## Plugin origin
This plugin was originally developed on Bukkit, the last update was in 2014 and the plugin did no longer receive any updates or bug fixes. As I stumbled across it while looking for a Bingo Plugin I decided to re-code a lot of the original code and make it compatible with 1.14.4 and the new way of handling items (names instead of ID's). There were also quite some bugs left unfixed and a lot of things were outdated due to it probably being coded around MC 1.8. Now we are in 2025 and I decided to pick it back up and convert it over to 1.21
